description: Figure 4 presents a bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment,” illustrating the computational efficiency of “Our Joint Framework” against four large language models (LLMs)—ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude—on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds),” ranges from 0 to 400 in increments of 50, while the horizontal axis lists the five models. “Our Joint Framework” is represented by a single dark green bar with a runtime of 77 seconds, significantly lower than all LLMs, which are shown as light blue bars: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds (the highest), LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. A legend in the top-left corner distinguishes “Our Joint Framework” (green) from “LLM Models” (blue). The chart visually emphasizes the substantial runtime advantage of the proposed ensemble model over individual LLMs in a streaming context.
